newsitem.title: USA: Mont. Colstrip 3 restarting, unit 2 seen up Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Mont. Colstrip 3 restarting, unit 2 seen up Thurs.

text.p: The 700 megawatt (MW) unit 3 at the Colstrip coal-fired power plant near Billings, Montana, will restart early Wednesday after being shut for unscheduled repairs, a Montana Power Co spokesman said Tuesday.
Colstrip's 330 MW unit 2 has also been shut for work on its cooling towers and is expected to restart towards the end of the week, the spokesman said.
Colstrip's 700 MW unit 4 and 330 unit 1 were said to be operating normally.
Montana Power is the operator of the Colstrip plant and is responsible for the sale of 30 percent of unit 4's power ouptut under long-term contracts.

Equity owners include Puget Sound Power and Light Co, Washington Water Power Co, Portland General Electric Co, Pacific Power and Light, and a consortium of GE Credit, Shell Oil Co and a lease-back firm.
